company.name: Atomo Coffee
company.shortDescription: Atomo Coffee produces coffee without coffee beans, using upcycled ingredients to create a sustainable and flavorful brew.
company.description: Atomo Coffee is a developer of molecular coffee. Atomo has reverse-engineered the coffee bean to create a smooth cup of coffee, made of naturally derived ingredients, and more sustainable than current commercial coffee.

aiResearchSummary.text: Atomo Coffee is researching modified coffee compositions and coffee substitutes by developing plant substrates treated by cross Maillard reaction, as described in methods for making post-Maillard cross-reaction substrate carrier materials to improve coffee characteristics. They are also working on cross-Maillardized plant substrates and methods for producing coffee and cacao substitutes using cross-Maillardized or non-cross-Maillardized carrier materials. These efforts focus on molecular coffee development.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
